waters.title: Senior UX Designer
waters.description:
Overview
Waters is developing solutions that make a meaningful impact on the world
Waters Helps Scientists in the Fight Against Cancer
Waters Helps Ensure The Quality & Safety of Food and Beverages
Waters Helps Drive Innovation in Chemical Materials
Waters Helps Scientists manufacture innovation for biodegradable plastics, safer cosmetics and latest consumer electronics
Waters Leads the way in helping scientists find ground-breaking treatments
As a Software Engineer at Waters Romania (Brasov), you will work on projects critical to our business needs.
Waters Corporation is looking for a Sr Interaction Designer (Contract) to join a dynamic, distributed team of designers and developers creating software that presents the capabilities and controls of scientific specialty measurement instruments for a wide range of end-user personas.
As a Sr Interaction Designer, the candidate must be passionate about all things UX ; striving for simplicity eliminating any areas of complexity and confusion. The Sr Interaction Designer will work in a dynamic environment, designing for a range of target platforms, including touch-only interface and fully responsive applications for desktop and mobile.
The candidate will work collaboratively with the product owner and the design lead to understand requirement needs and then work further with design and development teams to get the requirements into marketable customer-facing products.
Candidates should feel comfortable jumping in on a large project already in motion. Key successes will center around fast ramp up, clear communication and excellent delivery.
Position Details
Opportunity to extend contract.
This is a temporary position.
Responsibilities
As a Senior UX Designer you will:
Leverage AI tools and techniques for quality output and maximum efficiency
Follow and help extend and document established design language.
Work in fast paced design/dev environment against aggressive timelines.
Create prototypes for components, pages, and multi-page workflows.
Thoroughly document prototyped components and pages into development spec documents per established templates.
Collaborate with design and development teams on visual and interaction design details.
As a team member you will:
participate in all team meetings and ceremonies in direct collaboration with other sites, provide input and feedback, take ownership on identified improvements
actively participate in learning and sharing activities either during informal or formal training and demos
demonstrate continuous technical improvement
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Interaction Design and proven relevant experience
Experience in Adobe Suite of design tools and 2+ Figma experience required.
A passion for designing excellence and a thorough understanding of the craft.
Experience with interaction design, data visualization and general user interface design. Preferably designing for a range of platforms.
Experience working across functions and closely with teams – the ability to ignore ego and focus on iterating to the best solution.
Experience interviewing users and conducting guerrilla usability testing.
Company Description
Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of :16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.
Diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our core values at Waters Corporation. It benefits our employees, our products, our customers and our community. Waters complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to sex, race, color, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, marital status (including civil unions), military service, veteran status, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, legally recognized disability, domestic violence victim status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Waters is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

deel.title: Senior AI Design Engineer
deel.description:
Who We Are Is What We Do.
Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.
Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.
Why should you be part of our success story?
As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.
Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.
Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.
About The Role
Most teams use AI as a faster way for humans to build products. At Deel, we want to go further: build the system that lets AI build the products, with humans defining the taste, the guardrails, and the standards it works within.
That system is your product. You design and build the substrate AI generates against: the design system and component architecture, the generation and agent workflows, the quality gates that keep AI output production-ready, and the feedback loops that keep everything visible to the team. You stay hands-on as a designer throughout, because the fastest way to prove a generation system works is to design and ship real interfaces on top of it.
This is a senior individual contributor role. It is systems-first and craft-backed: you build the machine, and you use your own design ability to pressure-test it. You spend your time in Figma and in a code editor in roughly equal measure, you partner directly with design leadership to drive AI adoption across the whole design organisation, and you work as part of a cross-functional team alongside Engineering and Product rather than in isolation.
What You Will Do
Build the system that lets AI build products - Architect the design system, tokens, and components as the substrate AI generates against. Design prompt libraries, patterns, and agent workflows that turn design intent into production-ready UI with minimal human assembly.
Design hands-on to prove it - Stay a practicing designer. Explore concepts quickly, design real interfaces, and prototype in production front-end code so you are the first and toughest test of whether the system produces excellent, shippable work.
Own quality, guardrails, and evals - Define production-readiness criteria for AI-generated UI, design-to-code fidelity benchmarks, regression safeguards, and evaluation methods that keep AI output honest. Acceleration cannot come at the cost of craft.
Drive the AI workflow across the design org - Partner directly with design leadership to maintain, evolve, and roll out the AI-native workflow across the whole design organisation, not just your own work. This is a shared, ongoing responsibility, not a one-off setup: driving adoption, keeping standards current as tools change, and embedding the workflow across teams so it never depends on one person.
Work cross-functionally - Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, and design-system contributors. You complement engineering rather than replacing it, and you keep the system round-tripping to shared surfaces such as Figma so AI-accelerated output stays visible and open to feedback, never a black box.
Push into generative UI - Take AI beyond the build process and into the product itself. Prototype and evaluate adaptive, AI-generated interfaces as a product capability, and help shape where they belong on the roadmap.
Level up the team - Turn what works into playbooks, prompt libraries, and enablement so the wider design org builds on the system rather than depending on you. The goal is durable capability, not tool dependency.
What We Are Looking For
The heart of this role - You move fluidly between design and code. You don't need to be the deepest specialist in either discipline—what matters is you can design something well, build it yourself, and use AI to move quickly between the two.
Design - Real taste for layout, typography, interaction, motion; you care about polish
Code & prototype - Comfortable writing TypeScript/React (HTML, CSS, animation included). Prototype fast, moving between Figma and code to get from idea to working interface in hours rather than days
Systems thinking - Built or extended design systems others rely on
AI-native using AI design and coding tools in real work and keen to help shape new ones.
Seniority - 7+ years in product design + front-end engineering in complex products; comfortable with ambiguity and setting standards others follow
Total Rewards
Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.
Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission.
Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion.
Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location.
We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it.
Some things you'll enjoy
Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location
Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country
Optional flexible working office membership, with IWG
At Deel, we're an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @ deel.com and other acquired company emails like @ payspace.com and @ paygroup.com . You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page .
Deel welcomes persons with disabilities to apply to any of our open roles. We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email (recruiting@deel.com) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation.
As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations.
This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. Your personal data is not used to train AI models. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy.
For NYC Residents: In accordance with NYC Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on AEDT

defuse.title: Senior Product Designer (Full-Stack)
defuse.description:
About Defuse Labs
Defuse Labs builds NEAR Intents, the universal transaction layer for the AI economy — intent-based infrastructure that enables people, agents, and applications to move value across chains and assets without bridges, fragmented liquidity, or manual routing.
At the center of our product ecosystem is near.com .
near.com is building a permissionless financial account: one place to hold, grow, invest, trade and use assets across blockchains, with privacy and control at its core. Our ambition is to make sophisticated financial capabilities feel like parts of one coherent product, increasingly accessible through conversation and trusted agents.
Our initial customers are comfortable with crypto and value their time, privacy and independence. They want access to what financial technology makes possible without having to manage its complexity.
We also build NEAR Intents , the universal transaction layer for the AI economy — intent-based infrastructure that enables people, agents, and applications to move value across chains and assets without bridges, fragmented liquidity, or manual routing. Instead of specifying a transaction path, users simply express what they want to achieve, and a competitive network of solvers fulfills the intent with competitive execution across available liquidity.
We operate in startup mode: high ownership, fast execution, and high standards. We’re a small, globally distributed team that moves quickly, takes initiative, and adapts as the product and market evolve.
Responsibilities
Own the end-to-end design process across near.com , from discovery and product definition to interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and delivery.
Turn complex financial and cross-chain functionality into clear, intuitive, and trustworthy user experiences.
Design user journeys, information architecture, flows, wireframes, prototypes, and production-ready interfaces for web and mobile experiences.
Help shape how users interact with conversational interfaces and AI-powered financial agents.
Conduct user research, test assumptions, analyze product behavior, and use insights to improve the experience.
Build and evolve a scalable design system that supports a consistent experience across the product.
Contribute to product strategy and challenge requirements when a simpler or more effective solution is possible.
Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to define problems, explore solutions, and bring new features to market.
Help users understand what near.com makes possible and why it matters through thoughtful UX, product language, and visual communication.
Requirements
7+ years of experience designing and shipping complex digital products, ideally within fintech, crypto, or consumer finance.
A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product ownership, excellent interaction and visual design, and measurable product impact.
Proven ability to simplify complex systems and technical concepts into intuitive, trustworthy user experiences.
Strong proficiency in Figma, prototyping, and design systems, with experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering teams.
High level of ownership, sound product judgment, and familiarity with blockchain products, wallets, trading, DeFi, or cross-chain applications.
Nice to Have
Experience designing financial dashboards, wallets, trading products, portfolio tools, or AI-powered interfaces.
Knowledge of blockchain concepts such as signing, bridging, swaps, gas, permissions, and transaction states.
Experience with user research, product analytics, experimentation, or conversion optimization.
Ability to create high-fidelity interactive prototypes.
Familiarity with front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, React, or design-to-code workflows.
Experience establishing or scaling a design system in an early-stage product.
Recruitment Disclaimer
All personal data submitted by you as part of a job application, whether through our website, will be processed exclusively for recruitment and selection purposes. By submitting such data, you acknowledge and consent to its use for assessing your qualifications, contacting you regarding relevant opportunities, and maintaining a candidate profile for potential future openings.
For more detailed information about how your data is processed in the context of recruitment, including your rights under applicable data protection laws, please refer to our Privacy Policy , or contact us at legal@defuse.org
